systems.system: Births and Deaths Registry electronic database of registered deaths
systems.owner: Births and Deaths Registry, IT unit at the national office
systems.tiers: national office; completed paper Form 6 from 470 registries in 261 registration districts are scanned into it (2022)

note: The Births and Deaths Registry's 2022 death statistics: its national, regional, district and registry offices are a national agency's own, and the report states no connection at any of them, only paper forms scanned into a database at the national office; local authorities appear in the address (NALAG House) and the ministry's name.
